observations: Photo 0 shows a blue frame bicycle with very thick/big tires (fat-tire style).
Front wheel, fork, handlebars, and frame are visible; pedals and drivetrain area are partially visible.
No clear readable brand/model text on the frame or tires in the photo.
No accessories (e.g., pump, lights, helmet, lock, tools) are clearly shown in the photo.

claims.claim: Big tire bicycle with complete accessories
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the bicycle only; accessories are not clearly shown or listed with proof.

risks.risk: Whether the bicycle is complete and ride-ready (missing parts like pedals, reflectors, brakes, chain, or accessories).
risks.proof: A short video showing a full walk-around and a test ride, plus a laid-out photo of every accessory included (pump, lights, lock, tools, etc.).
risks.if_unproven: Price it as a bicycle only (no accessories) and assume it may need basic setup/parts.

risks.risk: Brake and drivetrain condition (brake rub, weak brakes, slipping chain, bent wheel).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of brake calipers/pads and chain/cassette area, plus a clip braking from slow speed and shifting through gears (if it has gears).
risks.if_unproven: Price it at worst case: brakes/drivetrain may need service.

risks.risk: Wheel/tire integrity (tire sidewall cracks, punctures, rim bends) and correct tire pressure.
risks.proof: Photos of both tires sidewalls and tread close-ups, and a clip spinning each wheel to show wobble.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as if tires/rims may require repair or replacement.

risks.risk: Frame size/fit and whether it matches the buyer’s needs.
risks.proof: Photo of the frame size/seat tube measurement (or size label) and the seller stating rider height range.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as a generic used fat-tire bike with possible fit uncertainty.

proof_requests: Lay out and photograph every included accessory (pump, lights, lock, helmet/tools/reflectors) and confirm quantities.
Video: start-up check (brakes, steering straight), then a short test ride showing braking and gear shifting (if any).
Close-ups: brakes (pads/rotors), chain/gear area, and both wheels for wobble.
Photos of tire sidewalls and tread, plus rim condition.
response.reason: The photo confirms a fat-tire bicycle, but the key claim about “complete accessories” and ride-ready condition is not provable from the single image. To price confidently, we need proof of included accessories and basic mechanical condition.
